summary: runs.json: the all-diagnostics build and every transfer of its zip are begin and end lines, the begin fsynced before the build starts, a begin with no end read as no-end (never done, never failed), a transfer recorded as complete, range, abandoned, error, head or refused as the server saw it, and the file held at its ceiling at the append. Beside it: the build each session ran (build_marker), an exit told by its status, the crash trace read for the thread that crashed (faulthandler writes it last), a crash loop named, and one whole-text scrub built on secret_scrub.scrubbed / exception_text (the passphrase in every form, a key statement's literal, the person's folders; checked again after the replacements; the cut last; withheld when it cannot be shown clean) for the run record, the fatal exception and the trace read (the log read as it was written: split on LF alone, strict UTF-8, a Windows log's CR LF read both ways, the torn start of an older block removed, a trace line held to 200 characters and 202 bytes); a chronology member held to its own bound; a marker unreadable on one boot read as unknown, not unchanged. The debug bundle's database sections share one snapshot session; after a damaged page invalidates its connection every later section failed on the dead transaction (SQLAlchemy's rollback-required error), so the session is rolled back (only when Connection.invalidated says so) before each database section.
